spec.name: Halloween Spectral Fish
spec.description: A small spectral fishing trophy with pale cyan glasslike flesh, luminous white skull and rib markings, and a forked purple tail. Static, axis-aligned geometry preserves open space between the fins and tail tips.

prompt: Small translucent-looking pale cyan fish with luminous white skeleton markings and purple fins, static axis-aligned cuboids for fishing trophy. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
